title: Caesar's Mini Sudoku 4x4
author: caesarcipher_org
rules:
Fill the 4×4 grid with digits 1-4 so that every row, column and 2×2 box contains each digit exactly once.
Grid (0 = empty):
0 0 2 0
4 2 0 3
0 4 0 1
1 0 0 2A short worked example and more classical-cipher puzzles are on CaesarCipher.org.
solutionCode: Enter the four digits of the third and fourth rows concatenated (8 digits, no spaces).
